title: Shy Martian, CamDaGuapo, and N8nassty take us "OUSSIDE" with a West Coast anthem.
htmlContent: Shy Martian's new single, "OUSSIDE," delivers late-night vibes with bass and swag. An assertion for the West Coast, this brooding anthem is infused with smoky late-night vibes that take you to the shimmering streets of Los Angeles once nighttime falls. With CamDaGuapo delivering raw verses and N8nassty sparking up on a feature with fire, Shy Martian's production strings it all together in a perfect combination of dirt and groove. https://open.spotify.com/track/74pxJJnqevNqBBfoyRADdF "OUSSIDE" hits hard with a beat that sounds cinematic yet rooted, combining airy synth layers with a confident and reflective track made for moving through the city, but affirming enough to make you reflect on the grind that puts you there. Shy Martian, fresh off co-producing tracks with 03 Greedo, also flexes his development as a producer here. The blend is clean, robust, and freighted with intention. The shared chemistry between the artists elevates the song beyond a typical collaboration, and it's a crew moment, a sound born of streets and studio nights that is viscerally true. "OUSSIDE" is a signature contemporary West Coast rap record, cinematic, brash, and unapologetically honest. Ideal for hip-hop heads, urban mood playlists, and anybody who knows that after midnight, the city has its own story to tell, and Shy Martian just gave it a soundtrack.
